fullDesc: On June 6, 1944 the Allies landed about 156,000 troops on five beaches in Normandy, the largest seaborne invasion in history. It opened the Western Front and led to the liberation of France.
realFacts: The beaches were Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno and Sword
Operation Overlord was led by General Eisenhower
Omaha Beach had the heaviest casualties
